purpose: FROZEN, append-only pre-registration ledger for the Scientific Progress Dashboard's Dimension 3 (Narrow) and Dimension 4 (Decide). One entry per open scientific question; each question carries a set of rival hypotheses that were pre-registered BEFORE their discriminating experiment ran (design rule 3). The initial hypothesis set is the FROZEN denominator of the reduction ratio -- it must never be padded after the fact. The ONE sanctioned way it may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out (see the labelled_fanout_growth invariant), which preserves the registration-time denominator separately so the ratio is always reportable both ways.
authority: This file is a derive-only INPUT. It never mutates claims.yaml, closure weights, or claim status. It is the human-adjudicated ledger appended at the same governance moment as /failure-autopsy -> /governance. build_hypothesis_space.py joins it against the live autopsy/manifest/evidence data to DERIVE surviving counts, momentum classes, decision-readiness state, and the time series. Nothing here is scored by the closure pipeline.

invariants.elimination_bar: A hypothesis may carry resolution.state == 'eliminated' ONLY with an adjudicated weakens (or a confirmed fan-out discrimination), met_elimination_bar == true, control_passed == true, and non_degenerate == true (design rule 4). check_hypothesis_space_integrity.py enforces this.
invariants.frozen_initial_set: initial_frozen_count_at_registration is fixed at registration and NEVER changes. initial_frozen_count tracks the current enumerated set and may only exceed it via LABELLED fan-out growth (see labelled_fanout_growth). A hypothesis's pre_registered_utc must be <= the resolved_utc of its adjudicating run (pre-registration before the experiment, never retro-padding).
invariants.labelled_fanout_growth: An EXISTING, already-adjudicated question's hypothesis set may legitimately grow when a GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination portfolio enumerates new rival explanations as earlier axes are eliminated -- but ONLY when all three hold: (a) STRICT FORM OF INVARIANT 3 -- growth is legitimate for legs whose adjudicating run has NOT yet resolved; a leg added after its own evidence is already in clears ONLY on GIT-WITNESSED provenance, i.e. its pre_registration_source artifact (or its own registry entry) was durably committed BEFORE the run resolved. The self-reported pre_registered_utc alone is NOT sufficient -- it is written after the fact and is trivially back-datable, so an audit reading only this file can never detect back-dating. The witness makes the honest case self-clearing with no human adjudication and the dishonest case detectable, because a commit date cannot be manufactured. Legs with no git history at all (uncommitted, wholesale rewrite, git unavailable) report as a quiet 'unverifiable' state -- not a violation, but not evidence either; (b) the growth is recorded as a machine-readable entry in the question's fanout_growth_events[] naming the autopsy that opened the portfolio (fanout_source) and listing the added hids; (c) initial_frozen_count_at_registration is preserved separately so the reduction ratio can be reported BOTH ways. Growth satisfying (a)-(c) is ADVISORY (labelled fan-out), not a violation. Growth that is unaccounted, unlabelled, or retro-padded remains a REAL bucket-(b) violation. NOTE: a growing denominator is itself a scientific signal -- a campaign that keeps inventing new candidate explanations as it eliminates old ones is FAILING to converge. The dashboard must report surviving/original AND surviving/current so this stays visible rather than being laundered into an improved ratio. DESIGN NOTE -- alarm fatigue is itself a Goodhart vector: a warn-only flag that recurs every cycle with a plausible narrative attached gets accepted by default (exactly what happened when 'benign per invariant 6' was cited for growth invariant 6 did not cover). Legitimate cases MUST self-clear on verifiable provenance so that a raised flag stays rare enough to be worth reading; silence-plus-a-narrative must fail where a git witness would pass.
invariants.human_owns_decided: decision.decided is set ONLY by a human via decision.decision_log_ref; the dashboard may say 'decidable_now', never 'decided', without it.
invariants.non_contributory_unchanged: A run whose evidence_direction is inconclusive/non_contributory and which does NOT discriminate a pre-registered leg leaves the tree counts untouched (it still appears in the momentum feed).

axis_families._purpose: COARSE, HUMAN-OWNED taxonomy grouping per-leg `axis` labels into families, so build_hypothesis_space.py can distinguish SUCCESSIVE REFINEMENT (a campaign closes out one family and opens a fresh one -- leg count grows while understanding narrows) from CIRCLING (new legs re-enter a family that already has eliminated legs) and SCATTERING (legs spray across families with none ever closed). The bare `fanout_added > 0` proxy it replaces could not tell these apart.
axis_families._authority: This map is ARGUABLE and belongs to the human, not the script. build_hypothesis_space.py computes over it and never invents or infers a family. Disputing a row here is the correct way to dispute a convergence verdict.
axis_families._unclassified_policy: An axis absent from `map` is reported as `unclassified` and forces the question's convergence_class to `indeterminate` -- it NEVER silently defaults into a family. Extend the map when introducing a new axis label (see /failure-autopsy Step 9b).
axis_families._provenance_caveat: These family boundaries were drawn on 2026-07-18 AFTER the competence_floor campaign had run, by a session that had already formed a reading of that campaign's shape. Confirmation-by-construction is a live risk: the taxonomy could have been gerrymandered to produce the verdict its author expected. Two partial checks -- (i) the boundaries are drawn on intervention LOCUS (what layer of the system a hypothesis blames), which is independent of any one question's outcome; (ii) applied to competence_floor it yields a NON-flattering result, classifying the 769 fan-out's drive-schedule leg as re-entry into an already-swept family. A taxonomy that only ever confirms would not do that. Neither check is decisive; treat the verdict as a reading, not a measurement.

_family_glosses.constitution: what the agent is endowed with BEFORE learning starts (innate drives, seeded priors, substrate capacity)
_family_glosses.process: HOW learning or decision proceeds (algorithm, credit, curriculum, exploration, selection, drive schedules)
_family_glosses.representation: WHAT is encoded or perceivable (state representation, readouts, observability)
_family_glosses.world: the TASK the agent faces (environment dynamics, reward structure, evaluation regime)
_family_glosses.instrumentation: whether the effect is MEASURABLE at all (metric validity, credit horizon as a measurement question)

questions.title: Why is committed competence stuck below the foraging floor?

fanout_growth_events.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination portfolio routed by the 769 autopsy (capacity axis empirically falsified; re-derive brake fired -> refuse same-axis re-queue). Three NEW rival axes pre-registered 2026-07-17T06:22:57Z, BEFORE their adjudicating runs V3-EXQ-770/771/772 resolved (07-17T13:45, 07-18T00:47, 07-17T13:23). Backfilled 2026-07-18 under the labelled_fanout_growth invariant.

GOV-FANOUT-1 successor portfolio opened when the 770/771/772 cluster eliminated all three prior axes, leaving 'which competence-directed dependency' unresolved. Both legs alive; adjudicating runs V3-EXQ-780/781 queued 2026-07-18 (unresolved, so (a) holds trivially). Backfilled 2026-07-18 under the labelled_fanout_growth invariant.

GOV-FANOUT-1 consumer half. RETENTION discrimination portfolio designed by session priceless-lewin-f47019 from the fanout_recommendation of failure_autopsy_MECH-457-gov-fanout-1-cluster-780-781-782_2026-07-18. QUESTION SHAPE CHANGED: the campaign's first ten legs asked which mechanism PRODUCES competence, every one adjudicated against an arm that never left the ~0-1 floor. V3-EXQ-780's raw_view arm reached 20.933 -- the FIRST supra-lift-target (13.05) observation in the campaign -- and RL then ERODED it to 11.667. The open question is therefore why produced competence is not RETAINED. ALL FOUR LEGS ARE SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED and NOTHING WAS QUEUED: /queue-experiment Step 2.5 stopped the portfolio (no distributional critic, no KL-anchor/frozen-policy snapshot, bc_aux_coef is a constant with no schedule, no consummatory act). Four complicated (buildable) nodes minted in substrate_queue.json; route is /implement-substrate. INVARIANT 3a(a) holds trivially and maximally cleanly -- these legs have NO adjudicating runs at all, so pre-registration necessarily precedes resolution. NUMERATOR HONESTY: this moves surviving/frozen from 2/12 = 0.167 to 6/16 = 0.375, which records that the question got WIDER, not that it narrowed -- the opposite direction from the padding the sanctioning decision flagged when it declined H-return-scale. Registering at fan-out DESIGN time, before any probe exists, is the moment this invariant sanctions; the producer-half autopsy deliberately deferred it honouring V3-EXQ-782's pre-declaration, and that deferral is discharged here. AXIS-FAMILY DISPUTE (recorded per axis_families._authority, which designates this as the correct mechanism for disputing a convergence verdict): a naive read scores this portfolio as CIRCLING because the process family already holds 6 eliminated legs. Two corrections. (a) The autopsy's caution overstates the arithmetic -- it says three of four axes map to process, but learning-signal maps to CONSTITUTION, so the split is algorithm+policy -> process (2) and learning-signal+intrinsic-architecture -> constitution (2). (b) The remaining re-entry is not circling, and the distinction is measurable: every eliminated process leg intervened on how competence is DISCOVERED and was adjudicated against an arm at the ~0-1 floor; these legs intervene on whether ALREADY-INSTALLED competence is RETAINED, are adjudicated from a 20.933 starting point, and read a TRAJECTORY. A retention deficit was not merely unobserved by the prior legs, it was UNOBSERVABLE to them -- an arm that never produces competence cannot be seen failing to retain it. DELIBERATELY NO `retention` AXIS INTRODUCED, hence no new axis_families.map row and no forced indeterminate convergence_class: axis_families is drawn on intervention LOCUS, and 'retention' is a question SHAPE. Minting a retention axis to escape an unfavourable score is exactly the confirmation-by-construction the map's own _provenance_caveat warns against. A critic swap is an algorithm intervention whether the question is discovery or retention. ANTI-ALIAS: H-retention-critic changes the VALUE ESTIMATOR, H-retention-consolidation changes the UPDATE CONSTRAINT; a leg changing both is disallowed, which is why the consolidation leg must anchor to a frozen snapshot of the installed policy rather than via bc_aux_coef (that would anchor to the demonstrator and alias with H-retention-auxiliary-decay).

questions.fanout_growth_note: This question's denominator grew 7 -> 12 across two labelled portfolios while 8 of its legs were eliminated. That is genuine discrimination-portfolio enumeration, NOT retro-padding. SUPERSEDED READING (kept deliberately, 2026-07-18): this note previously concluded 'the campaign has not converged -- it is inventing new candidate explanations as fast as it rules old ones out.' The axis-family discriminator falsifies that. Four families (instrumentation, process, representation, world) are closed out and the live frontier `constitution` is fresh territory with zero eliminations, so the classification is REFINING: the count grew while the KIND of answer narrowed. The campaign swept the whole 'tune the learner' category and moved to 'what is the agent constituted with'. The honest residue is the 769 portfolio's partial_re_entry (H1-drive-schedule landed in the already-swept `process` family) -- refinement, but not a clean sweep. Still report the ratio BOTH ways (see labelled_fanout_growth); a growing denominator remains worth reading, it just is not by itself evidence of failure.

hypotheses.label: competence-directed behavioral prior (imitation seed)
hypotheses.desc: seed the composed actor with a BC-of-policy warm-start / imitation auxiliary distilled from a floor-clearing demonstrator (local_view_greedy or oracle)

resolution.basis: NOT ELIMINATED -- V3-EXQ-780 ran but does not discriminate this leg, and its self-route bc_prior_not_the_axis is REJECTED on autopsy. The pre-registered null is verbatim 'treat still forages ~0 both reps'; raw_view treat forages 11.667 at unshaped D3 eval (17.993 train-recent, 20.933 immediately post-BC), so the null's ANTECEDENT IS FALSIFIED and its consequent must not be applied. The experiment's OWN declared covariate decides this: load_bearing_dv states 'post_bc_foraging_competence separates seed never took from seed erased by RL', and it fires into two branches, NEITHER of which is the self-route. z_world: post_bc 0.583, 0/3 seeds took the BC seed -- manipulation NEVER INSTALLED, arm uninformative. raw_view: post_bc 20.933, 3/3 seeds took -- manipulation installed ABOVE the 13.05 lift-competence target (inside the 32.72 BC-expert band, vs a 48.05 local-view ceiling), then ERODED by RL to 11.667. Readiness met; non_degenerate=True; criteria_non_degenerate all true -- the defect is in the interpretation grid, which enumerated only a ~0 null, not in the instrumentation. RE-POSED: 20.933 is the FIRST observation in this campaign of the agent exceeding the lift-competence target, so the leg's open question shifts from whether a behavioural prior can produce competence (it can) to why the substrate does not RETAIN it. V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) supplies the leading mechanism candidate -- a flat, uninformed critic on the shared CTRL path (std(V)/std(G)=0.041 vs a 0.25 collapse threshold; pre-reward-vs-far separation 0.016 vs a 0.25 floor) yields an unbaselined high-variance advantage, exactly what drifts a policy off an installed prior. Secondary: the z_world imitation pathway is its own implementation gap (0/3 install). Routed to a retention re-pose under a NEW EXQ number (re-derive brake permits: new question, new null, new measurement, and a positive control no prior leg had). Adjudicated in failure_autopsy_MECH-457-gov-fanout-1-cluster-780-781-782_2026-07-18.

hypotheses.label: innate non-extinguishing competence-directed approach drive
hypotheses.desc: a sustained, demonstrator-free appetitive-approach drive toward resources, architecturally distinct from novelty-class drives (RND/SD-025) that self-attenuate via familiarity

resolution.basis: An innate, non-extinguishing, demonstrator-free appetitive resource-proximity drive (approach_coef=1.0) on the non-regressed reference build does not lift foraging competence on either representation: treat 0.317 (z_world, ctrl 0.300) and 0.200 (raw_view, ctrl 2.983) against a 1.0 floor and a 13.05 lift-competence target; 0/3 seeds supra-target on either rep. Trustworthy on three independent checks: (1) MANIPULATION EFFECTIVE -- the declared covariate mean_approach_reward_recent reads 0.698/0.707 in treat vs 0.000 in both ctrl, so the drive fired and was earned; (2) NULL READABLE -- V3-EXQ-782 R-(a) found forage |adv| mass already concentrated pre-standardisation (C_pre 1.92/1.20 vs a 0.5 threshold), so the MECH-459 weak form under which this inside-the-normaliser null would have been confounded does not hold, resolving Finding V3 of decision_MECH-459_registry_and_brake_2026-07-18.md in favour of a face-value read; (3) SUBSTRATE CAN EXPRESS COMPETENCE -- the co-adjudicated V3-EXQ-780 raw_view arm reaches 20.933 on this same substrate when a competent policy is installed by BC, so the null is not a can't-express-it artifact (a positive control this leg did not contain internally and which only joint adjudication supplies). Readiness met (local_view_greedy 48.05, greedy_oracle 57.2 vs the 1.0 floor); non_degenerate=True. LOAD-BEARING POSITIVE FINDING: in raw_view the drive SUPPRESSED foraging (0.200 vs a 2.983 ctrl, tight across all three seeds 0.15/0.20/0.25) while approach reward was continuously earned -- approach-without-consummation, the appetitive drive becoming terminal rather than instrumental. That is a discovered dependency (consummation/commitment binding) converging with the standing BG-commitment reading, not a new axis. Adjudicated in failure_autopsy_MECH-457-gov-fanout-1-cluster-780-781-782_2026-07-18.

hypotheses.measurement_requirement: MANDATORY: records the post-installation competence TRAJECTORY, not terminal competence -- terminal-only measurement is precisely what kept this deficit invisible for ten legs. synthesis.surviving_label: competence-directed bootstrap (behavioral-prior OR approach-primitive) -- which is the open discrimination
synthesis.text: Floor = success-dependence + capacity-to-convert. FOUR axes now eliminated (capacity 769; drive-schedule 770; reward-coupling 771; credit-horizon 772): the learned actor-critic converter cannot extract a competent policy from a provably-sufficient observation, invariant to all config/env/credit/capacity levers. questions.title: Does the control plane carry two independent degrees of freedom, or collapse to one scalar?

hypotheses.label: score-bias and temperature are independent axes
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (i): the MECH-320 tonic_vigor score-bias axis and the MECH-313 noise_floor temperature axis route to distinct E3 softmax parameters and produce non-collinear behavioural effect vectors (rank 2)

resolution.basis: 777a narrowed nothing, but for a NEW reason. Sampling is genuinely repaired (all 56 cells reached 250 fresh E3 selections, zero starved cells) and all six preconditions were MET, so control_passed and non_degenerate are true for the first time. C1 still failed -- NOT on collinearity: mean_sin_angle 0.5454 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and c1_seed_count PASSED (3 of 4 informative seeds, required 3). The sole failing bar, c1_robust, is defined as mean minus POPULATION SD (statistics.pstdev, script line 541/697) and so cannot be met at any n; repaired to standard-error form it needs ~51 informative seeds against an observed 28.6% informative yield (~177 raw seeds, ~31 h). That yield is substrate-gated: corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884 with 9 of 14 seeds saturated, a property of an untrained agent's degenerate action-value distribution that barely moved from 777's starved run. Hypothesis stays ALIVE -- a substrate-ceiling non_contributory discriminates nothing. Note the surviving evidence points TOWARD this leg, not away: within the informative pool the angle does not track score-axis magnitude (corr 0.028) and the best-conditioned seed 17 gives sin_angle 0.9883. Re-derive brake FIRED; pending SD-PROBE-WARMUP, not a further lettered iteration.

hypotheses.label: tonic baseline and phasic transient are independent DOF on one readout
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii): the MECH-313 tonic noise_floor moves the sustained baseline entropy while the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst moves an event-locked transient on the same E3 temperature readout, with cross-legs ~0 (double dissociation)

resolution.basis: 779a came CLOSE to resolving this leg: the load-bearing double_dissociation_C1_and_C2 criterion PASSED (criteria_non_degenerate true, robust true, diss_seed_count 4 = min_seeds 4; mean_dS_tonic +0.265 sd 0.072, mean_dR_phasic -0.048 sd 0.037). It was withheld only because phasic_fires_real_events measured 6 vs threshold 10, a MIN across cells sourced entirely from seed 23 / T1P1. Capability is RULED OUT: burst_level_max is 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell including both seed-23 cells, and seed 23's firing rate (7.2-11.9 ticks per 1000 env steps) sits inside the range other seeds span (seed 29: 8.8-9.6). Seed 23 got 835 of 2400 env steps because it dies in ~7 steps per episode and the 120-EPISODE cap bound first -- the only cell with stop_reason episode_cap against 15 step_cap cells. The withholding is CORRECT: seed 23 is one of the four dissociating seeds and carries the largest phasic effect (-0.108) on 6 event ticks; excluding it leaves 3 < min_seeds 4. non_degenerate false, so the elimination bar is not met and the leg stays ALIVE -- but it is one exposure fix (V3-EXQ-779b) from adjudication.

hypotheses.label: the control plane collapses to a single scalar
hypotheses.desc: the rival reading: apparent tonic/phasic and score/temperature distinctions are reparameterisations of one underlying control scalar, so no genuine second degree of freedom exists

resolution.basis: Both adjudicating runs have now completed and BOTH produced evidence pointing AWAY from collapse -- 777a's mean_sin_angle 0.5454 exceeds the 0.500 non-collinearity margin with its best-conditioned seed at 0.9883, and 779a's double-dissociation criterion PASSED robustly on 4 seeds. NEITHER cleared the elimination bar, however: 777a is a substrate-ceiling non_contributory (informative yield 28.6%, criterion bar unreachable) and 779a is non_degenerate false (readiness unmet). No bits may be claimed against this rival. It stays ALIVE and remains untested; the apparent support 777 once lent it was withdrawn by the predecessor autopsy and nothing here revives it.

decision.decision_question: Does the REE control plane retain >=2 independent control degrees of freedom, or is it effectively one scalar?
decision.live_gate: Sub-claim (i): SD-PROBE-WARMUP -- a trained-enough probe substrate giving D_action_mass dynamic range (brake-enforced; a further lettered iteration is refused). Sub-claim (ii): V3-EXQ-779b -- step-denominate max_episodes_per_cell so max_env_steps_per_cell binds for every cell; NOT blocked on SD-PROBE-WARMUP.
decision.distance_phrase: Four runs spent (777, 779, 777a, 779a), zero of three hypotheses eliminated. The 777a/779a iteration repaired the sampling defect that stalled the first pair -- and in doing so SPLIT the bottleneck in two. Sub-claim (i) is now substrate-ceilinged (informative-seed yield 28.6%, capped by action-value saturation in an untrained agent; corr 0.884) and its re-derive brake has fired. Sub-claim (ii) PASSED its double-dissociation criterion robustly and is withheld only by one contributor's exposure -- it is a single cap parameter from adjudication. The space is still unnarrowed, but for the first time the two legs are separately actionable.
decision.observation_bottleneck: Split as of 2026-07-18. Sub-claim (i): DYNAMIC RANGE -- the score axis's dependent variable is saturated on 9 of 14 seeds (corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884), a property of an untrained agent's degenerate action-value distribution that survived a fully repaired sampling model, capping informative yield at 28.6% against the ~51 informative seeds the criterion needs. Sub-claim (ii): EXPOSURE -- an episode-denominated cap (120 episodes) truncated the criterion's largest contributor to 835 of 2400 env steps. The predecessor's sample-starvation reading is SUPERSEDED: sampling was repaired and was demonstrably not the binding constraint.

questions.title: Do the SD-068 consolidation-pipeline per-phase readouts measure content fidelity, or raw noise sensitivity?

hypotheses.label: the SWS denoising readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: sws_denoising_snr scores the preserved deviation-structure of injected clean prototypes, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance rather than raw noise sensitivity

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 1.0000 (sd 2.7e-8, 95% CI [0.99999997, 1.00000001]) on 8/8 seeds -- the zero-content null arm reproduces the injected arm's sigma-slope to eight decimal places. Structural, not statistical: noise_power is identical across arms at every sigma while signal_power is 5585.7 vs 0.0, so denoising_snr_db = 10*log10(signal/noise) has a sigma-slope driven entirely by log(noise_power) and the content term differentiates away. Readiness precondition met (injected slope 0.0665 >> 1e-06) and criteria_non_degenerate true, so the control discriminated cleanly.

hypotheses.label: the NREM transfer-fidelity readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: nrem_transfer_fidelity measures the fraction of the injected-content gap closed by the CrossModuleConsolidator pass, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 0.1445 (sd 0.00090, 95% CI [0.1438, 0.1451]), 0/8 seeds confounded, verdict stable, CI well below the 0.25 ceiling and not straddling it. The null arm's slope is ~14% of the injected arm's, so the readout is substantially content-contingent. Necessary-not-sufficient for SD-068's full 3-phase contract: this is the ONLY phase confirmed content-contingent.

hypotheses.label: the REM precision-calibration readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: rem_precision_error scores |running_variance_after - 1/target_clean| against an injected known target precision, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.self_route_label: substrate_not_ready_requeue + measurement_still_degenerate_requeue (both superseded by the joint read)
resolution.basis: ELIMINATED as the direct complement of H-rem-genuinely-content-free being confirmed -- the two are mutually exclusive readings of the same readout and the joint evidence discriminates between them. Once 778d's unpaired-target null removes the clamp degeneracy (7/8 seeds de-railed, clamp fractions mostly 0.0), the null arm STILL tracks the injected arm's sigma-slope: content-contingent on only 1/8 seeds, unclamped ratios 0.577-0.995 against a 0.25 ceiling. 778e's independently de-clamped readout agrees on every non-degenerate seed (0.999 / 0.998 / 0.326, all ABOVE the ceiling). Positive controls passed in both legs (injected slopes 0.0665 and 0.0771, both >> the 1e-06 floor, on 8/8 seeds). The rem calibration readout responds to noise magnitude, not content fidelity. Residual: one dissenting seed (778d idx 3, ratio 0.0011) and a wide ratio spread (sd 29.8, CI [-9.08, 32.18]) whose instability runs TOWARD content-freeness.

hypotheses.label: the REM null degeneracy is a clamp artifact of the step=1.0 measurement choice
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The full-adoption step=1.0 linear interpolation drives calibration_error into its positivity floor / saturation constant, so the null arm cannot express a graded slope regardless of content-contingency

probe_amendments.retired_probe: re-run the rem leg over a step ladder (0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0) and read whether the null arm leaves the 998.5 constant and the 1e-3 floor. Declared null: if the null arm stays railed at every step, this leg is refuted.
probe_amendments.retired_reason: PROVABLY INERT -- would have returned this leg's own declared null BY CONSTRUCTION. ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py recalibrate_precision_to computes rv_after = (1-step)*rv_before + step*(1/(target+1e-6)), so (a) the max(1e-3, raw_target) positivity clamp is applied to corrupt_target UPSTREAM of step, making the clamp fraction and the null-series distinct-value count EXACTLY step-invariant, and (b) both arms' sigma-slopes carry the same linear factor step, which CANCELS in the reported ratio |null slope| / |injected slope|. Verified numerically over step in {0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0}: ratio identical to 12 significant figures (14569.1833719598-...602, float round-off only), clamp fraction and distinct-value count bit-identical. A positivity-floor ladder fails for the same reason: the null arm's reference is centred on ZERO, so it clamps on ~half the draws at ANY floor value. Running it would have written a false elimination into the frozen ledger rather than a measurement.
probe_amendments.replacement_probe: UNPAIRED-TARGET null. ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED points the recalibration at an INDEPENDENT positive target of the same magnitude class (log-normal, positive by construction), unpaired with the clean target the error is scored against -- the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, NO PRIOR PAIRING' analog, versus the zero-content null which removes the pairing AND pushes the parameterisation off a cliff. ARM_NULL_ZERO (the 778c null) is retained as a replication anchor.
probe_amendments.replacement_declared_null: if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too -- still clamping, still constant -- this leg is REFUTED and the measurement axis is eliminated from the question.
probe_amendments.detected_by: pre-queue design audit of V3-EXQ-778d, before any compute was spent
probe_amendments.witness_commit: ree-v3 18c4687 (main) -- 'SD-068 GOV-FANOUT-1: queue the 3-leg REM discrimination portfolio (V3-EXQ-778d/e/f)'
probe_amendments.integrity_note: The amendment precedes the adjudicating run: witness commit 18c4687 and this record both predate any V3-EXQ-778d result manifest, and resolved_utc is still null. pre_registered_utc (2026-07-18T08:41:15Z) is unchanged and the hid is unchanged, so the git-witnessed pre-registration check still resolves against the original fan-out commit. The hypothesis under adjudication is UNCHANGED (the degeneracy is an artifact of the measurement rather than a property of the readout); only the probe is.

resolution.control_rehabilitation_note: control_passed is asserted on the CORRECTED both-rails predicate, NOT the shipped one-rail predicate. The shipped readiness anchor (v3_exq_sd068_rem_unpaired_null_diagnostic.py:288) scores `railed` as NOT(clamp_frac<=0.2 and n_distinct>=3 and n_unclamped>=3), which detects only the SATURATION rail; V3-EXQ-778c's degeneracy was documented at BOTH rails (saturation AND positivity-floor collapse). The three floor-collapsed seeds are therefore scored HEALTHY, capping a bit-perfect replication at 5/8 = 0.625 against a >= 0.75 gate -- the precondition is unmeetable by construction. The anchor's underlying data DID reproduce 778c to identical floats across three independent runs ([4348.4665081785715, 0.0, 9142.771353766831, 0.0, 1801.6453681003277, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] in both 778d ARM_NULL_ZERO and 778e's legacy anchor, matching 778c's recorded 0.0-on-5/8 / 1801-9143-on-3/8). criteria_non_degenerate.C1 = readiness_ok AND anchor_ok with readiness_ok true on 8/8, so the degeneracy flag traces ENTIRELY to this one mis-specified statistic. Post-hoc rehabilitation, adjudicated at the interactive gate 2026-07-18 and labelled as such. Clean-as-shipped re-run routed as V3-EXQ-778h (low priority, ledger hygiene; NOT a blocker on this resolution).
resolution.basis: CONFIRMED on the load-bearing criterion: C1_unpaired_null_derails PASSED, 7/8 seeds, ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED clamp fractions [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.2]. The leg's declared null ('if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too, this leg is REFUTED') did NOT trigger -- the unpaired null left the rails. The V3-EXQ-778c both-rails degeneracy WAS an artifact of how the zero-content null was operationalised. Note this is orthogonal to content-freeness: the degeneracy being an artifact and the readout being content-free are BOTH true (see H-rem-genuinely-content-free). Probe was amended pre-queue -- the original step-ladder was proven algebraically inert (step cancels in the reported ratio; verified identical to 12 sig figs over step in {0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0}) and would have returned this leg's declared null BY CONSTRUCTION; the unpaired-target replacement is the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, no prior pairing' analog. Amendment witnessed at REE_assembly master 2970e2112c / ree-v3 18c4687.

hypotheses.label: the REM calibration readout is genuinely content-independent, like SWS
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The rival reading: the clamping is incidental and a de-clamped readout would still show a null slope ratio near 1.0, making rem a second content-free leg

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED on the JOINT 778d+778e evidence, per GOV-FANOUT-1's requirement that portfolio legs be read jointly. 778e ALONE narrows nothing: its precondition declamped_null_series_non_degenerate is unmet (5/8 seeds saturate at n_distinct 1) and its C1 fails on those degenerate zeros -- a zero slope from a saturated constant is not evidence of content-contingency. But 778d's de-railed ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED is a NON-DEGENERATE observation of the same quantity (7/8 seeds de-railed, injected readiness cleared 8/8), and it shows the null still tracking the injected slope: content-contingent on 1/8 seeds, unclamped ratios [0.995, 0.901, 0.877, 0.0011, 0.577, 85.18, 0.574, 3.295] against a 0.25 ceiling. 778e's three NON-degenerate seeds agree independently (0.999 / 0.998 / 0.326, all above the ceiling). De-clamping changed the SCALE (9143 -> ~1.0) but not the PATTERN -- the same five seeds saturate -- so the degeneracy is not a units artifact. control_passed true (injected-arm readiness cleared on 8/8 in BOTH legs); non_degenerate true (778d's unpaired arm). RESIDUAL STATED HONESTLY: one dissenting seed (778d idx 3, unclamped ratio 0.0011, strongly content-contingent, on a legitimately de-railed arm), and the unpaired-arm ratio estimate is unstable (mean 11.55, sd 29.77, 95% CI [-9.08, 32.18], ceiling_inside_ci95 true) -- but the instability runs TOWARD larger ratios, i.e. toward more content-freeness. Direction not in doubt; magnitude not estimable. Confirmed 7/8, not 8/8.

hypotheses.label: rem_generative_gain is a content-free transfer-function property
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The attenuating generative gain (0.149, 8/8) may be a property of the rollout transfer function rather than evidence that 'correction needs an intact seed' -- which would undercut the sd_068 doc's line-221 gloss without touching the attenuation finding itself

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED cleanly as shipped -- the only leg of the portfolio that needed no rehabilitation. Precondition control_input_corruption_range_supra_floor met (1.5646 vs 0.05) on the content_scale=1.0 positive control; all three criteria_non_degenerate true; manifest non_degenerate true. Load-bearing C1_gain_flat_in_content_scale PASSED: mean gain delta (1.0 minus 0.0) = -0.009662 against a pre-registered separation bar of max(0.05 absolute floor, 2 x SEM = 0.0117) = 0.05, separated false. The declared null required the gain to be above the bar WITH monotonicity; it was an order of magnitude below. Mean gain by content scale 0.1589 / 0.1520 / 0.1493. TWO points against the retracted gloss: (i) a consistent monotone ordering does exist (7/8 seeds) but is exactly the consistent-but-tiny case the bar was built to reject; (ii) its SIGN IS INVERTED -- gain is LOWER with intact content than with none -- opposite to what 'correction needs an intact seed' predicts. SCOPE GUARD HONOURED: this does NOT overturn the attenuation finding (rem_generative_gain 0.149, attenuating 8/8 seeds), which STANDS and is recorded at every content scale (8/8 attenuating at 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0). Only the interpretive gloss in the sd_068 architecture doc's OPEN QUESTION box is retracted.

decision.decision_question: Can the SD-068 harness's damage-tolerance staging order be read as functional damage tolerance at all, or only as noise sensitivity?
decision.distance_phrase: RESOLVED 6/6. Four runs spent (V3-EXQ-778c, then the 778d/778e/778f GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio, n=8 seeds each). Of three per-phase readouts, ONE is a working content-contingent instrument (nrem); sws was eliminated as content-free by construction and then REBUILT and validated (V3-EXQ-778g); rem is now confirmed content-free across three design axes and is NOT a functional-damage instrument. The generative-gain pillar is content-free too. So the staging order CANNOT be read as functional damage tolerance -- it rests on two of three phases, with the third measuring noise magnitude.

questions.title: Why is the z_world manifold under-differentiated -- an untrained encoder, or a world_dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling?

hypotheses.label: the world encoder is never trained in the measured configuration
hypotheses.desc: SplitEncoder.world_encoder receives no gradient during P0 (the loop buffers latent.z_world.detach() and optimises only agent.e2.parameters()), so the manifold is an untrained projection regardless of its width.

resolution.basis: 783 crosses {dim 32,128} x {untrained,trained} at n=8 paired seeds. Training lifts the z_world contrast ratio at BOTH dims (dim32 +0.0814, t=+7.26; dim128 +0.1074, t=+13.11), both CI95 clear of zero. All four preconditions MET, including the positive control (raw channel CR 0.8138 vs a 0.2 floor) and the weight-movement check that read 0/61 on the x734 configuration and reads 7 here.

hypotheses.label: the world_dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling
hypotheses.desc: The 2026-06-06 cluster autopsy's substrate_ceiling / pending_retest_after_substrate leg: 32 latent units cap the discriminable structure z_world can carry, so contrast should rise with dimensionality.

resolution.basis: Raising world_dim 32 -> 128 lifts contrast at NEITHER training state: untrained -0.0032 (t=-0.73, CI95 [-0.0135,+0.0071]), trained +0.0228 (t=+1.60, CI95 [-0.0110,+0.0566]) -- both straddle zero at n=8 paired seeds. The emitted mixed_partial_separation label turned on the trained delta exceeding a bright-line 0.02 minor-axis ceiling by 0.0028 against its own SEM of 0.0143, and does not survive a noise-aware read (autopsy section 3, user-adjudicated). The 2026-06-06 substrate_ceiling verdict on this leg is refuted by its own user-confirmed retest spec.

synthesis.surviving_label: untrained encoder (a1) -- z_world under-differentiation is a training fault, not a dimensionality fault
synthesis.text: z_world under-differentiation is a TRAINING fault, not a DIMENSIONALITY fault. SD-070 (ree-v3 main f418400) supplies the missing gradient path and demonstrably works (world-path weight-delta 7; participation-ratio retention 0.658 against the prescribed pre-SD-070 P0's collapse to PR ~1.06). Q-002's HARD PRECONDITION remedy clause 'resolve via SD-005 / higher-dim z_world' is refuted as a route and should be corrected to a trained encoder; the precondition itself is NOT lifted, since no run has yet swept RBF resolution on an SD-070-trained encoder.

decision.decision_question: Is z_world under-differentiation caused by an untrained encoder or by a dim-32 granularity ceiling?
